payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of repetitive and time-consuming activities handled by Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) systems.

claims.text: IPA systems handle repetitive, routine, and low-cognitive tasks, allowing workers to focus on more intelligent processes.
RPA systems simulate hand-operated human activities like entering data, registering accounts, and accomplishing straightforward repetitive workflows.
IPA-bots can execute time-consuming and routine tasks, enabling smart workflows and freeing up skilled workers for higher-value activities.
